TC-25/S14.title: Generate on the phone, then the phone leaves at once: the note still reaches the computer
TC-25/S14.detail: PW, local stack, both modes: two signed-in contexts of one fresh physician — the computer (Desktop Chrome) on the chart's Post-Round tab, the phone (Pixel 7 profile) on the Encounter tab. The phone typed the encounter (kept on the server), tapped Generate Note & Finish (its generateNote mocked at its own socket, answered 8 s after it is asked) and its browser context was closed 1.2 s after the tap (stands in for lock, background or leaving). The computer waited 120 s with no reload: in both modes it still showed 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' (Hospital also the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button) and no note was ever stored; no failure message either. Judged U8 (UAT 3.5 / TFA-92592 AC 15): FAILED in both modes; the dictation is kept (passed). U4 / U6 (TFA-94513 in progress, TFA-94704 backlog) are todo, not judged. On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). The same loss is confirmed on dev with the real model (TC-14/S07 dev). Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run.
TC-25/S14.productIssue: A physician who taps Generate on the phone and pockets it (or the app is closed) gets no note anywhere: the computer keeps showing 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' and nothing says the note was lost.
